commitMessage:
Rebrand to Pantauku: name, logo, icons and page title

- New Pantauku logo (map pin + wordmark) replaces the Traccar logo
- Regenerated favicon and PWA icons from the new pin icon
- Page title, description, PWA manifest name and theme color set to
  Pantauku / #FF6A00 instead of server-provided placeholders
- Login side panel logo rendered in white on the orange background
